title: feat: build arcane tower defense
body:
## Summary

- replace the artillery prototype with a portrait Arcane Defense game
- add 20 tower tiles, five summonable tower types, matching-tower merges, and automatic combat
- add Reaper scythe attacks with a 5% one-strike defeat chance

- `godot --headless --path . --fixed-fps 60 --time-scale 10 --quit-after 600`
